manifest.name: monthly_sales_by_category_best_worst
manifest.description: Totals monthly sales revenue and units by product category from sales_2026.csv and reports best and worst month overall and per category.
manifest.purpose:
a bot that totals our monthly sales by product category and tells me the best and the worst month

Files: folder novak_trading
manifest.headline: Your best month was {best_month.month} with {best_month.revenue_czk} CZK in sales, and your worst was {worst_month.month} with {worst_month.revenue_czk} CZK.
examples: Which month had the highest sales?
Show me my sales by product category each month
What was my worst performing month?
manifest.manual_basis: Aggregating sales data from transaction files by month and category, then identifying peak and trough periods.
